input.text: The bug is that the palindrome test happens before the string is normalized. You need to build a cleaned version of the input where every letter is lowercase and the space characters are gone, then compare that cleaned version with its reverse. In Python you can lowercase a string with its lower method and remove the spaces with its replace method, chaining them on the value returned by input. Do those two transformations first, and only then check equality with the reversed string.
